meta.title: Why the whole world is fighting over one tiny chip

scenes.headline: Why the world is ==fighting== over a [[tiny chip]]
scenes.sub: And why one island makes almost all of them
scenes.narration: This is the most important object in the modern economy. And almost nobody has seen one.
It powers your phone. It trains every AI model. And increasingly, it decides who wins.

scenes.title: One island, one bottleneck
scenes.narration: Most of the world's most advanced chips are made right here, on an island smaller than many countries' provinces.

scenes.kicker: Share of the most advanced chips
scenes.label: made by ==a single company==
scenes.narration: Roughly ninety percent of the most advanced chips come from a single company.

scenes.title: Who spends the most on new chip factories
scenes.subtitle: Illustrative capex, $ billions
scenes.narration: And the race to build more factories is staggeringly expensive.

scenes.title: Demand for AI compute keeps climbing
scenes.narration: Since the generative AI boom, demand for compute has exploded.

scenes.headline: Smaller transistors = __more power__
scenes.body: Each new generation packs billions more switches into the same tiny square of silicon.
scenes.narration: The trick is shrinking transistors, so each generation fits billions more switches on the same square of silicon.

scenes.title: From sand to supercomputer
scenes.narration: Design happens in one place, fabrication in another, packaging somewhere else, and the finished chips end up training AI.

scenes.title: A short history of the chip race
scenes.narration: It took decades to get here: from the first integrated circuit, to the microprocessor, to dedicated foundries, to today's AI boom.

scenes.title: Two strategies
scenes.narration: Governments are trying two strategies at once: pay to build factories at home, and restrict who can buy the best chips.

scenes.headline: New rules tighten ==chip exports==
body: Officials said the measures aim to slow rivals' access to advanced hardware.
Industry groups warned that ==the rules could raise costs== for everyone.
Analysts expect further restrictions over the next year.
scenes.narration: Each new rule triggers a response, and the costs ripple through the entire industry.

scenes.title: 9 in 10
scenes.label: advanced chips depend on ==one supply chain==
scenes.narration: Nine out of ten advanced chips depend on one fragile supply chain.

scenes.text: Whoever controls the chips, controls the ==future of computing==.
scenes.author: A common line among analysts
scenes.narration: As the saying goes: whoever controls the chips, controls the future of computing.

scenes.title: What to watch next
items: Custom AI chips from big tech
scenes.narration: So what should you watch? New factories coming online, more export rules, and custom AI chips from big tech.
